Lets give you a quasi-rundown of what happened: We all arrived in tower 6 in the courtroom, there's this judge, extremely fat. Rolls on rolls we're talking. He gets his assistant Jefferey, a toothpick of a man to call up the next criminal named Gee. Gee was a chef accused of something something (mainly irrelevant) which he pleas not guilty and the Judge got him to cook a meal to see if he was lying and Gee did the best he could, even impressed bellyrolls. The Judge was so impressed that he wanted to be the last person to taste Gee's cooking so he ordered Jefferey to cut off Gee's hands and pluck out his eyes and tongue before sending him home. After that peacocking of power, Dart (my sharkman) was up next. The Judge asked if he was guilty of the assassination of a councilman (not the other stuff though), but he ended up saying Yuuup guilty after calling the Judge dinner and the assistant the toothpick he'll use to pick out the fat that gets stuck between his teeth... but the Judge didn't hear it and told Dart to move along, so he did. Mallory (portrayed by Bella) was next and was asked guilty or not over arson and the deaths of 12-or so kids. She pleaded (and by that I meant she was nearly grovelling, and hysterical- and I'm not just saying that because she was playing a women (MISOGYNY CAM STRIKES AGAIN) it was impressive) not guilty and asked the Judge & co to investigate more. He makes a big fuss about her being noisy and annoying and if she has any proof bec the proof he has is her casefile that literally says she was there and did it which was good enough for him. She gets sent to the side as 'guilty' and is then she goes to stand by Dart.

Jade's character Mellathor was pretty unceremonious. Guilty. Murder. simple. The Judge did ask him if he was juicing though. Like, was he on roids, and when Mellathor said no, the Judge said bullshit you're definitely juicing and sent him off to stand with Mallory and I. Then the pretty boy dragon man... with the Lee special hair part and swoop. Yuntao was unimpressed by this entire display, and chose to pick a fight with the Judge calling him all sorts of things. It was very _very_ entertaining for Dart. Especially when the Judge told Jefferey to restrain him and Yuntao grabbed Jefferey by his suitjacket and went, "_Don't you fucking dare touch me_" and Jefferey said, "You best unhand me or I will cut yours off." Yuntao then proceeds to slap Jefferey in the face with his tail and Jeffery pins him down and the Judge looks at him amused before he glares back up at the Judge and THEN JEFFEREY PLUCKS ONE OF YUNTAO'S EYES OUT AND CRUSHES IT FOR LOOKING AT THE JUDGE FUNNY. IT'S NOT EVEN THE 30MIN MARK AND AVIA AND LEE FUCKING MADE ANOTHER BLIND LEE CHARACTER. Man. I should've known. Remember to bet on a missing eye-ed Lee OC next time he makes a character. Put all your stocks into it. Yuntao looks like he's about to get up and MELLATHOR comes in and helps pin him down of all things. Maybe this happened before the eye was plucked out and led to it, but regardless, the DRAMA. Dart, to add insult to injury went "Hey, didn't you also say you were going to cut off his hands?" And Jeffery goes, "Oh yeah. Here," AND PROCEEDS TO BREAK HIS LEFT ARM FROM THE ELBOW DOWN AND THEN CUT OFF HIS HAND. I think at this point, Yuntao like was forced to stand off on the side with us... Otherwise he would've straight up died.

We all then get the offer to die or go to Tower 7, Mallory still yapping asks if she can get her sentence checked out but they deny her and tell her that if she wants to she can do that in Floor 4 (we have MOTIVATIONS NOW). Two unnamed NPCs go, "aww no wayyy I'd rather die wah wah" and then they get all _omae wa mou shindeiru_'d and Jefferey cuts their heads off. We all go Tower 7, obviously, and we get led to a metal dome of sorts. On the way, there were two guards that Yuntao knew so he lunged at them to spook them which was a cute gesture. Inside the dome (which would be our elevator down to 7) Mellathor started working out doing squats and Dart went over to Mallory to ask about the Not Guilty plea because he found that very fascinating and she divulged some more information (like she's from Tower 6, she would never harm children, and that she's a path of the patron). She in turn asked Dart if he actually killed anyone and he very as-a-matter-of-factly and total dead-pan went "Well yes, of course I'd say guilty because I did it." Mallory was in disbelief and was asking why anyone would want to do that and Dart confirms that he is indeed a contract killer, so that was normal for him. To this she turns away from him and doesn't really want to talk to him anymore so he walks over to Yuntao and apologises for mentioning the hand.

Yuntao says there's no need to apologise which stumps Dart, so he pivots into asking him some questions and saying it'd be best if they work together to make their way back up, but also that they will definitely swing by Tower 6 to kill the Judge and Jefferey (which wins some brownie points). Yuntao during this conversation was given his hand back re-attaches it and starts to heal it with his magic and raises that he doubts the viability of Mallory as he thinks she'll be a liability. Dart counters by saying he has a good feeling about her, but also if push comes to shove, keeping her around would be like keeping around a slow person in case you need to outpace a bear which nets him even more brownie points from the dragon boy.

The dome starts moving down and when we land, we're met with another Jefferey (but he's different). Dart gets up and offers a hand to Mallory who accepts and then walks over to Jefferey and asks him to unlock their cuffs because they've been debuffed and wouldn't pose a problem to which he complies. Jeffery then tells us we're all in Tower 7, it's got it's own laws and the chance of survival is 2%, but we get 24 hours of down time, one set of new jumpsuits and we're only allowed to take one ration pack. Dart changes into the new bright orange jumpsuit, and then takes two ration packs and looks back to Jefferey to see if there's a reaction... and he didn't care so he picks up a third. Mellathor grabs 5 rations and then asks Jefferey if he wants to exercise with him and after was turned down, goes into a side room and exercises before sleeping. Dart took notice of this and because he knows Mellathor was from Tower 7 (thanks to his conversation and interaction with the New Jefferey) dragged a bed out of a side room and put it next to Mellathor's room so he could wake up when Mellathor leaves his room. Yuntao takes some rations too and then leans against the wall on the other side of Mellathor's room and closes his eyes to sleep (holy shit he's so edgy with the wall lean and missing eye and busted arm/hand... ![🫦](https://discord.com/assets/bb8e626699a9e277.svg)). Mallory takes her rations, but she grabs like the most and combines them into 4 bags and then goes into her own room to schnooze. Jefferey wakes us up 20 hours later and everyone gets up to eat food, with Mallory waking up first. He then tells us we have to leave or die, but can ask any question. Mellathor asks about the rest of the Minotaur race who were last spotted in Sector 2, and a map of the regions (Avia, truly an artist and visionary). Yuntao asks about a certain Cobalt Order, finds out 3 members are here but the last any were spotted was in Sector 2. Dart had a lot of asks and found out quite a bit of further information.

He found out that Sector 1 is the industrial zone, 2 is the redlight district, formerly the battle zone, 3 is unknown, and 4 is the new battle zone. S1's previous chief was a gnome who automated/revolutionised iron ore. It has "Dangerous Automation" and it offers a Technical escape. S2's previous leader was a battle hardened creature who was defeated trying to fight Jeffrey. Now occupied and the main danger here are Succubi, and you could try get out to Tower 6 by becoming crime bosses. S3's previous leader was Unknown, dangers are Unknown, and you'd have to figure out your own way out. S4's previous boss was killed in the Cycle of 32 (a cycle is a little over a year?), is the current Battle Zone, and you can go here if you want to Fight your way out to Tower 6(very difficult). He also asks Jefferey if he can give the four of them communication devices which was granted in the form of the magic limiters in our wrists (which has been inserted to every person at birth apparently?) being upgraded to have a sending stone-esque feature of 20words or less at the cost of fatigue. He also asks the way out so we don't die which was a big metal door. So, W Dart moves, my precious rough-skinned boyo mwah. Mellathor pushes him aside and asks for a jacket and uh... I'm sure it was something else and was granted so at the expense of 3 of his rations. Dart seeing this tosses his rations toward the door out and then asks for a cloak which he got for free. Mellathor in seeing this runs for his rations and Dart tries to get them back because in the night he made some makeshift ropes which he tied to his rations (this was a retcon that I asked if I was allowed to have done LMFAO) but Mellathor won the die roll so instead Dart asks Jefferey to get his rations back which he does by paralysing Mellathor xD Mallory asks for flint and steel and a jacket for some rations and goes to leave. Yuntao was already by the door just watching all this (we all got maps after Mellathor asked for one)

Jefferey then tells us that our questions were cutting down our allotted time here and we only had a few minutes left and Mellathor WASTES THEM BY ASKING FOR AN AXE REPEATEDLY TO WHICH HE WASN'T ALLOWED SMH!! But it's fine and we all get out and are greeted with the sight of slums as far as the eye can see. We had some more yaps out here but the important part was that Mellathor thinks Mallory is dead weight and would wind up a slave in Sector 2 (crazy work). Apparently we were standing on a bridge of Hardlight which was an Overwatch reference??? Idk, it meant nothing really to me xD and we walked down toward Sector 1 because Mallory convinced Yuntao and Mellathor that they should arm themselves with weapons or shields from the industrial zone. Dart was just watching the interactions and tagged along as they all walked towards Sector 1. As we were leaving the Hardlight bridge, we were being approached by 2 silly little guys (former prisoners) and Mellathor charged one and kicked him in the face, and started scrapping with the second. The one that was kicked was pushed towards Yuntao and they started having a go at each other before Yuntao went to sear the hoof mark into the poor dude's face and burn the guys throat as he choked him out (the guy is knocked out). Back to Mellathor... well, he's stomped old mate's head in, no contest, but there was a third guy sneaking up to him and Avia asked if Mallory or Dart would like to intercept and Mallory jumped in and did some sick choke throw situation and pinned him down. Dart the entire time stood back and surveyed his potential new teammates and was taking mental notes on them but also got to see where the were all hiding their rations and such which he was given the option to stealthily steal them from everyone else, but instead he chose to tell the 3 where they were hidden for them to take instead (1 shiv to Mallory and Yuntao, 1 broken shiv to Mellathor, 1 ration to them each).

Sharkboy then goes to the one Yuntao downed and wakes him back up but he's a little bitch boy and just starts screaming so Dart knocks him back out. He then goes to the one Mallory is holding down and smiles at him with his full set of shiny and sharp shark teeth ![😁](https://discord.com/assets/7fff0841b901c035.svg) and greets him with a "Hello!" Dart then gets information out of him such as Thraxis, the collective leader of Sector 1, a robot with multiple bodies, AND the location to their base and decides to keep him around as a guide/pet. Mallory, again proving to be the moral compass and heart of the group asks for his name (Jordan) and even chose to leave him with some rations for himself. He takes us (and his burnt friend who Yuntao was dragging by the collar) to our new base of operations, his old home and takes us in through the side entrance because the front door was trapped. As Mellathor and Dart were a bit to big for the side entrance, they got Mallory to disable the shotgun pointed at the front door, and the molotov aimed above it. A summation of our base (which Avia is going to make in Shanty Town) is it's a near a cliff and is 4 stories. Floor 1 1 Kitchen, 1 bathroom, 1 sleeping room, 1 common area. Floor 2: 2 bedrooms, 1 terrace. Floor 3: 1 bedroom, 1 storage room (crates, wires, ropes, metal pieces). Floor 4 broken glass, cold (broken Air Con). I forgot to mention, but the heat of Sector 1 is a bit abrasive to Dart, so he's quite fond of the broken Aircon that's constantly blowing cold air. Inside, Mallory wants a break from the 3 upstairs and heads down with Jordan who wants to check in on his friend. There Jordan asks Mallory to kill his friend and put him out of his misery... but instead she gives him some rations and the guy says he's going to leave and try survive elsewhere. Mallory gives him the molotov as a flare of sorts if he gets in trouble/for self defence. Upstairs, the other 3 check out the storage room which just has building materials and they head downstairs to find -1 burnt guy...

Mellathor wasn't pleased, Yuntao thought he was stupid, and Dart wanted to do a bonding exercise but decided that this isn't quite the atmostphere for that. They argue for a bit and then Jordan breaks it up by saying it's quiet time and we should all sleep and before he could explain a giant drone x4 the size of Mellathor glides past our building and starts scanning things. Mallory goes up to the terrace to keep an eye out for the burnt guy if he needed help with the molotov, and eventually retires. Yuntao sleeps. Dart slept in the shattered glass room after clearing some glass, and Mellathor stands guard for half the night and then wakes Dart up for the next shift and then sleeps where Dart did and that's where we ended session 1!
